Entre sus espacios figuran Minitas Beach: Venues include Minitas Beach Club, La Piazzetta, Lago, La Caña, SBG and La Casita. In-villa chef and private catering options are also listed. Meal plans depend on the booking.
The Spa ofrece masajes, tratamientos fac: The Spa offers massages, facial treatments and a hydrothermal circuit with a sauna, steam room and pools. Ask your dentist when these activities are appropriate during your treatment.
La marina reúne servicios náuticos, tien: The marina combines nautical services, shops and dining. Altos de Chavón offers galleries, crafts and an amphitheatre. Check access and schedules directly with Casa de Campo.
Centro de raquetas, equitación, polo, ti: A racquet centre, horse riding, polo, shooting and excursions. Activities have their own booking arrangements, participation requirements and possible charges.
El complejo dispone de organización de b: The resort offers wedding planning, meeting facilities and concierge services. The hotel has a 24-hour reception and staff to help arrange services during your stay.
Casa de Campo es una alternativa hoteler: Casa de Campo is an independent accommodation option. Accommodation, access and activities are booked separately; availability, rates and inclusions depend on the resort’s terms. Information checked on its official website on 7 November 2026.
El Dr. Víctor Lappost desarrolla su prác: Dr Víctor Lappost practises at Centro Odontológico Aquazul in La Romana, focusing on oral rehabilitation and dental implants. He combines clinical practice with university teaching at UNIBE.
El repositorio institucional de UNIBE lo: UNIBE’s institutional repository identifies him as an advisor to a 2025 study comparing conventional complete dentures and milled PMMA dentures. This academic contribution relates to the study of restorations and oral rehabilitation processes.
La universidad también lo incluye como v: The university also lists him as a member of the Dental School Alumni Association’s committee for the 2023–2026 period. At Aquazul, his professional profile highlights oral rehabilitation, implants and teaching.
